auditor.independence: Separate session from the translator (i18n-translator, session 3ef6295a5545, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5). Read-only: this run wrote no catalogue, English source, context sidecar, ledger, allowance or generated file.

scope: zh-CN ui.common.time, the four s16d keys (today_at, yesterday, weekday_at, date_at) at PR #1877 head b2110ea9; judged end to end through the real formatDividerLabel / formatMessageDateTime under locale zh-CN, not as isolated strings.
method: Re-hashed the landed files at head b2110ea9 with `sha256sum` and compared against the bytes audited on the pre-landing candidate: all four values byte-identical, whole-file 111c7c99..., 4-pair canonical f053f4fa... .

Bundled the app's real modules (message-grouping.ts, date-utils.ts, i18n/messages.ts, i18n/locale.ts) with esbuild from the landed tree and drove formatDividerLabel/formatMessageDateTime under locale zh-CN with NOTHING registered, so the values came from the shipped bundled catalogue: 今天9:05 / 今天14:30 / 昨天14:30 / 星期一8:15 / 2026年10月5日16:45.
Parsed both sides with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and compared placeholder names/types; checked NFC, bidi controls, markup/backticks and Latin residue; 0 plural/select messages in the group.
Ran negative controls (English left, dropped placeholder, renamed placeholder, NFD, bidi control) against the same detectors; all fired after the first-pass detector gap was fixed.

Ran the repo validators in a scratch mirror of the landed tree: generate --check (byte-identical), check-coverage (ok, 7 gated languages, 0 allowed keys), context-parity (ok), locale-parity.test.mjs (44/44) and zh-CN-activation.test.mjs (3/3).

findings.problem: No separator before the clock, so the label composes to 2026年10月5日16:45 (同样 weekday_at -> 星期一8:15). Recorded, not churned: the zh-CN style guide forbids a space between Chinese and Latin/digit runs, the corpus follows that for digit joins (第2步，共5步) and the sibling yesterday_at = 昨天{time} does the same; the colon disambiguates so no meaning is at risk.
findings.suggested: If a wave/designer decision prefers the typographic space, change all four clock-bearing keys at once to 今天 {time} / 昨天 {time} / {weekday} {time} / {date} {time}; never one of them and never a full-width ，.

verdict: clean-with-findings — 4/4 keys landed byte-identical to the audited candidate; blocker 0, major 0, minor 0, nit 1. Nothing English remains in the four values or in the composed divider labels; RTL does not apply to zh-CN.
observations: Pre-existing and outside this group: ui.teamBridge.threadRow.last writes 今天 {time} / 昨天 {time} WITH a space, so zh-CN will show both joins; a corpus consistency item for a later pass, not a defect of these four values.
Formatter-side, not catalogue copy: {weekday} is Intl weekday:'long' (星期一); a compact surface could use 'short' (周一) if width ever demands it.
limitations: Catalogue + message-runtime audit only, plus code-point cell arithmetic against the English sources: no rendered screen, screenshot or measured layout, and no native-speaker sign-off. Visual QA and design review remain separate gates.
